summary: Mobile and tablet UI workflows passed, including dashboard, modes, handover note creation/filtering, recipes, allergen modal, production advancement, More tabs, reset control, and tablet overflow check. Backend state test was blocked by public /health routing.

critical.issue: Public preview URL returns the Expo HTML shell (HTTP 200) rather than the FastAPI JSON health response, so health.json() fails. Internal supervisor logs show FastAPI /health works on port 8001; ingress routing is incorrect for this root path.

action_items: Fix public ingress so /health reaches FastAPI (or expose a correctly routed API health endpoint), then rerun backend round-trip tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend .env defines EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL but not the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current app does not visibly call the backend and uses local storage for state, so backend persistence integration remains unverified.

success_rate.backend: 0% (health assertion blocked; state round-trip not reached)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ note through the API test payload; cleanup was not reached because public health failed before PUT.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the public preview URL. UI selectors should use accessibility label Chiudi etichetta for the icon-only close control. Modal, recipes, note flow, production, More tabs, and 768px overflow passed.
rca_of_issue: The FastAPI app declares root /health correctly, but the configured public hostname routes non-/api paths to Expo. This makes /health return index.html with HTTP 200. Internal backend logs confirm /health 200 on port 8001. The API state route should be separately verified after fixing or confirming ingress routing.
